entries.toelichting: From √mara (be-fat); stall-fed beast (2Sa 6:13; 1Ki 1:9,19,25; Isa 1:11; 11:6; Eze 39:18; Am 5:22). 8 occurrences. Standard.
Pre-Deuteronomistic name of Mephibosheth (1Chr 8:34; 9:40). Means 'contender-of-Baal'. Hyphenated; English convention preserves the original-name form.
Place where Israel quarreled with YH (Ex 17:7; Num 20:13,24; 27:14; Deu 32:51; 33:8; Ps 81:8 [7]; 95:8; 106:32). 7 occurrences. Means 'strife/contention'. English convention.
Variant of H4807 (1Chr 9:40). English convention with hyphen.
Multiple persons (1Chr 5:32-33; 6:6-7,52; 9:11; Ezr 7:3; Neh 11:11; 12:15). 7 occurrences. English convention.
Sister of Moses (Ex 15:20-21; Num 12; 20:1; 26:59; Deu 24:9; 1Chr 5:29; Mic 6:4) and a Judahite (1Chr 4:17). 14 occurrences. English convention.
Hapax (Pro 14:10). The bitter-grief of the heart. Standard.
From √rakav (ride); war-chariot or royal-chariot (Gen 41:43; 46:29; Ex 14:25; 15:4,19; Jos 11:6,9; Jdg 4:13,15; 5:28; 1Ki 7:33; Isa 22:18; Eze 27:20; Hag 2:22; etc.). 46 occurrences. Standard.

From √ramah (deceive); fraud / treachery (Gen 27:35; 34:13; Ps 5:7 [6]; 10:7; 17:1; 24:4; 34:14 [13]; 35:20; 36:4 [3]; 38:13 [12]; 50:19; 52:6 [4]; 55:12,24 [11,23]; 109:2; Pro 11:1; 12:5,17,20; 14:8,25; etc.). 39 occurrences. Standard concordant. Distinguished from H8267 sheqer (falsehood) and H7423 remiyah (slackness/deceit).
Hapax (1Chr 8:10). Person of Benjamin. English convention.
Multiple persons (Ezr 8:33; 10:36; Neh 3:4,21; 10:6 [5]; 12:3). 6 occurrences. English convention.
From √ramas (trample); the trampling-action (2Ki 9:33; 14:9; 2Chr 25:18; Isa 5:5; 7:25; 10:6; 28:18; Mic 7:10; Eze 34:19). 7 occurrences. Standard.
Patronymic of Meronoth (1Chr 27:30; Neh 3:7). English convention.
From √rea (companion); close-companion (Gen 26:26; Jdg 14:11,20; 15:2,6; 2Sa 3:8; Pro 19:7; 28:24). 7 occurrences. Hyphenated.

From √raah (graze/shepherd); grazing-place (Gen 47:4; 1Chr 4:39-41; Job 39:8; Ps 74:1; 79:13; 95:7; 100:3; Isa 32:14; Jer 23:1; 25:36; 49:20; 50:45; Lam 1:6; Eze 25:5; 34:14,18; Hos 13:6; Joe 1:18; Zep 2:6,14). 13 occurrences. Standard.
Variant of mireh; the act-and-place of grazing (Ps 74:1; 79:13; 95:7; 100:3; Jer 10:21; 23:1; Eze 34:31; Hos 13:6; Mic 5:3 [4]; Zep 2:14). 10 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Hapax (Jos 19:11). Place in Zebulun. English convention.
Hapax (Eze 34:19). The trampling-of-clear-water by sheep. Hyphenated.
Verb 'be-pungent / be-grievous / pierce' (Job 6:25; 16:3; 1Ki 2:8; Mic 2:10). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used twice (Ex 21:6; Deu 15:17). The piercing-tool for the slave's-ear ceremony. Standard.
Hapax (Esth 1:6). Mosaic-floor of Persian palace. Hyphenated.
Verb of polishing/burnishing/purging (Lev 6:21 [28]; 1Ki 7:45; 2Chr 4:16; Isa 49:2; Jer 46:4; Eze 21:14-16 [9-11]; etc.). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Hapax (Song 5:13). Lover's cheeks as spice-banks. Hyphenated.
Verb of being-bitter / making-bitter (Gen 49:23; Ex 1:14; 1Sa 30:6; 2Ki 14:26; Ru 1:13,20; Isa 24:9; 33:7; Lam 1:4; Eze 27:30; Zec 12:10). 14 occurrences. Hyphenated stative.
Used (Ex 12:8; Num 9:11; Lam 3:15). Passover bitter-herb-of-affliction. Hyphenated technical-term.
Used (Deu 32:32; Job 16:13; Lam 3:5,19). Gall as bitter-poison. Hyphenated.
Levitical line (Gen 46:11; Ex 6:16,19; Num 3:17,20,33-37; etc.). 39 occurrences. English convention.
Hapax (Jer 50:21). Code-name for Babylon. English convention.
Hapax (Gen 10:30). Place in Arabia. English convention; distinguished from H4337/H4338 (Mesha-Calebite, Mesha-Moab) by lexical entry.

Substantive of nasa (lift); the prophetic-burden (Isa 13:1; 14:28; 15:1; 17:1; 19:1; 21:1,11,13; 22:1; 23:1; 30:6; Nah 1:1; Hab 1:1; Zec 9:1; 12:1; Mal 1:1; etc.). 37 occurrences. Hyphenated. Considered: oracle (NIV), burden (KJV), pronouncement (NRSV). The kernel is the lifted-up-thing — both 'load' and 'utterance'. Compound preserves both poles.
Arabian tribe / Ishmaelite son (Gen 25:14; 1Chr 1:30; Pro 30:1; 31:1). 27 occurrences. English convention.
Variant entry (Gen 25:14; 1Chr 1:30). Hyphenated to disambiguate from H4853b.
Levitical city in Asher (Jos 19:26; 21:30). English convention.

From √nasa (lift); the lifted-thing — fire-signal (Jdg 20:38,40; Jer 6:1), gift-tribute (Gen 43:34; 2Sa 11:8; Jer 40:5; Esth 2:18), uplifted-burden (Zep 3:18), face-uplift / acceptance (Gen 4:7; Job 41:25 [17]). 16 occurrences. Standard.
Used (Isa 37:3; 2Ki 19:3; Hos 13:13). The birth-stool / opening-of-the-womb. Hyphenated.
Place in Moab (Jer 48:1). Means 'the high-place'. English convention.
Verb (Ex 2:10; 2Sa 22:17; Ps 18:17 [16]). The act of drawing-out-of-water (root of the name Mosheh). 3 occurrences. Hyphenated.
The lawgiver-prophet (Ex-Deut narrative; references throughout OT and NT). 764 occurrences. Standard English convention. The name links to mashah (draw-from-water, H4871) per Ex 2:10.
Hapax (Ezr 6:18). Aramaic mention of Moses' law. Hyphenated.
Used (Pro 1:32; Jer 2:19; 3:6,8,11,12,22; 5:6; 8:5; 14:7; Hos 11:7; 14:5 [4]). Apostasy / backsliding. 13 occurrences. Hyphenated.

From √sus (rejoice); the rejoicing-state (Job 8:19; Ps 48:3 [2]; Pro 8:30,31; Isa 8:6; 24:8,11; 32:14; 60:15; 62:5; 65:18; 66:10; Jer 49:25; Lam 2:15; 5:15; Eze 24:25; Hos 2:13 [11]). 17 occurrences. Hyphenated.

Verb of pouring-oil-on-head for consecration (Ex 28:41; 29:7,29,36; 30:26,30; 40:9-15; Lev 7:36; 8:10-12; etc.). 68 occurrences. Standard concordant. Covers anointing of priests (Aaron), kings (Saul, David, Solomon), and cult-furniture. The participle form gives mashiach (H4899).
Used twice (Ezr 6:9; 7:22). Aramaic for temple-oil. Hyphenated.
From √shachat (destroy); the destroying-agent (Ex 12:23; Jer 4:7; 6:28; 22:7; 51:1,25; Eze 5:16; 9:1,6; 21:36 [31]; Pro 18:9; 28:24; 1Sa 13:17; 14:15). 11 occurrences. Standard.
Hapax (Ps 110:3). Disputed; the dawn-womb of birth-from-the-east. Hyphenated.
Hapax (Lev 22:25). Defective-animal disqualified for sacrifice. Standard.
Hapax (Isa 52:14). The marred-appearance of the suffering-servant. Standard.

Substantive participle of mashach; the anointed-one (Lev 4:3,5,16; 6:15 [22]; 1Sa 2:10,35; 12:3,5; 16:6; 24:7,11; 26:9,11,16,23; 2Sa 1:14,16,21; 19:22 [21]; 22:51; 23:1; 1Chr 16:22; 2Chr 6:42; Ps 2:2; 18:51 [50]; 20:7 [6]; 28:8; 84:10 [9]; 89:39,52 [38,51]; 105:15; 132:10,17; Lam 4:20; Hab 3:13; Dan 9:25,26). 39 occurrences. Hyphenated 'anointed-one' captures the substantive-participle morphology and avoids the theological-tradition transliteration 'Messiah' (which is itself the Hebrew word transliterated, not a translation). KJV uses 'anointed' (39 times) except Dan 9:25-26 ('Messiah'); ESV uses 'anointed'. Concordant kernel preserved across all 39 occurrences.
Used twice (Job 28:18; Ps 126:6). Pouch / sowing-bag. Hyphenated.
Son of Japheth, northern people (Gen 10:2; 1Chr 1:5,17; Ps 120:5; Eze 27:13; 32:26; 38:2,3; 39:1). 9 occurrences. English convention.
From √shakav (lie); bed / resting-place (Gen 49:4; Ex 21:18; Lev 15:4-26; Num 31:17,18,35; Jdg 21:11,12; 1Sa 26:7; 2Sa 4:5,7,11; 1Ki 1:47; etc.). 46 occurrences. Hyphenated.
From √sakal (be-prudent); psalm-of-insight, used as title for thirteen Pss (32; 42; 44; 45; 52-55; 74; 78; 88; 89; 142). Also of Ps 47:8 [7]. 13 occurrences. Hyphenated technical-term.
Used (Lev 26:1; Num 33:52; Pro 18:11; 25:11; Eze 8:12; Ps 73:7). Engraved-figure / pictured-stone. Hyphenated.

From √shakan (dwell); the dwelling-shrine (Ex 25:9; 26:1-37; 27:9-21; 35-40 chapters; Lev 8:10; 17:4; Num 1:50-53; 3:7,8,23-38; 4:16-49; 7:1-89; 9:15-22; 10:11-28; 16:9,24,27; 17:13 [28]; 18:31; 19:13; 31:30,47; Jos 22:19,29; 1Sa 2:22; 2Sa 7:6; 1Chr 6:33,49; 16:39; 17:5; 21:29; 23:26; 2Chr 1:5; 5:5; 29:6; Ps 26:8; 43:3; 46:5 [4]; 74:7; 78:60; 84:2 [1]; 132:5,7; etc.). 138 occurrences. Standard concordant. Distinguished from H168 ohel ('tent') and H1004 bayit ('house'). 'Tabernacle' is the technical-term; the LXX 'skēnē' preserves the dwelling-aspect.

Verb of ruling/governing (Gen 1:18; 3:16; 4:7; 24:2; 37:8; 45:8,26; Ex 21:8; Deu 15:6; Jos 12:2,5; Jdg 8:22-23; 9:2; 14:4; 15:11; 1Sa 9:17; 2Sa 23:3; 1Ki 4:21,24; 5:1,4; etc.). 82 occurrences. Concordant 'rule' captures the broader governance-kernel; distinguished from H4427 malak ('reign', specifically royal). mashal includes non-royal authority — the sun rules the day (Gen 1), sin rules over Cain (Gen 4:7), husband rules wife (Gen 3:16). KJV uses 'rule/dominion'; concordant 'rule' is the kernel.
Verb 'be-like / make-like' (Job 30:19; Isa 14:10; Eze 31:2,8,18; 32:2; Ps 28:1; 49:13,21; 102:7; 143:7). 7 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used twice (Dan 5:1 [4:34]). Disputed; meaning-significance / weight-of-words. Hyphenated.
From √shalach (send); the sent-thing (Deu 12:7,18; 15:10; 23:21 [20]; 28:8,20; Esth 9:19,22; Isa 11:14; 25:11; Eze 25:7). 7 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used (Esth 9:19,22; Neh 8:10,12). The festival gift-of-portions. Hyphenated technical-term.
Used twice (Job 30:11; Ps 78:49). Discharge / unleashed-troop. Hyphenated.

Multiple persons in post-exilic lists (2Ki 22:3; 1Chr 3:19; 5:13; 8:17; 9:7-12; Ezr 8:16; 10:15,29; Neh 3:4,6,30; 6:18; 8:4; 10:8,21; 11:7,11; 12:13,16,25,33; 13:23). 25 occurrences. Means 'recompensed/dedicated'. English convention.
Hapax (2Ki 21:19). Wife of Manasseh. English convention.
From √shamar (keep); the watch-station / prison (Gen 40:3-7; 41:10; 42:17,19; Lev 24:12; Num 15:34; 17:7; Neh 3:25; 7:3; 12:9,24; 13:14,30; Job 7:12; Eze 38:7). 25 occurrences. Hyphenated.

From √shamar (keep); the duty-watch (Gen 26:5; Ex 12:6; 16:23,32-34; Lev 8:35; 18:30; 22:9; Num 1:53; 3:7-8; 8:26; etc.). 78 occurrences. Hyphenated technical-term for priestly/Levitical guard-duties.
Used (Isa 42:22,24; Hab 2:7; Zec 14:1; Eze 25:7; 2Ki 21:14). Spoil / booty. Standard.
Used (2Sa 22:19; Ps 18:19 [18]; Isa 36:6; Eze 29:6). Support / staff. Hyphenated.
Used (Gen 38:18,25; Ex 21:19; Num 21:18; Jdg 6:21; 2Ki 4:29,31; 18:21; Isa 36:6; Eze 39:9; Zec 8:4). 11 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Hapax (Isa 5:7). The bloodshed-pun on mishpat. Hyphenated.

Clan / extended-family unit (Gen 8:19; 10:5,18,20,31,32; 12:3; 24:38,40,41; 28:14; 36:40; etc.). 304 occurrences. Standard concordant. Distinguished from H1004 bayit (household), H7626 shevet (tribe), H1121 ben (children/sons-of).

Substantive of shaphat (judge); judicial-decision / right / ordinance (Gen 18:19,25; 40:13; Ex 15:25; 21:1,9,31; 23:6; 24:3; 26:30; 28:15,29-30; etc.). 423 occurrences. Standard concordant. Distinguished within the legal-vocabulary five-fold: H1881 dat (decree-law, Persian-loan), H2706 choq (statute-decree), H4687 mitsvah (commandment), H4941 mishpat (judgment-ruling), H8451 torah (instruction-Torah).
Used twice (Gen 49:14; Jdg 5:16). Saddle-bags / fold-pens. Standard.
From √shaqah (give-drink); beverage (Gen 40:21; Lev 11:34; 1Ki 10:5,21; 2Chr 9:4,20; Ezr 3:7; Neh 1:11; 2:1; Isa 32:6; Hos 2:7 [5]; etc.). 13 occurrences. Standard.
Used (Gen 13:10; Eze 45:15; 47:9; Lev 11:34; etc.). Well-watered land. Hyphenated.
From √shaqal (weigh); a measured-weight (Gen 24:22; 43:21; Ex 30:13,24; 38:24-29; Lev 19:35,36; 26:26; Num 7:13-86; 18:16; etc.). 49 occurrences. Standard.
Used twice (Isa 28:17; 2Ki 21:13). The measuring-line of judgment. Hyphenated.
Used (Dan 3:5,7,10,15). Aramaic for the reed-pipe of Nebuchadnezzar's orchestra. Hyphenated.
Used twice (Num 19:6; Isa 33:12). Lime-burning / cremation. Standard.
Used twice (Gen 36:36; 1Chr 1:47). City of Edom. English convention.
Verb of feeling-about (Gen 27:12,21,22; 31:34,37; Ex 10:21; Deu 28:29; Job 5:14; 12:25). 9 occurrences. Standard.

From √shathah (drink); banquet-with-drinking (Gen 19:3; 21:8; 26:30; 29:22; 40:20; Jdg 14:10,12,17; 1Sa 25:36; 1Ki 3:15; Esth 1:3,5,9; 2:18; 5:4-14; 6:14; 7:1-8; 8:17; 9:17-22; Job 1:4-5; Pro 15:15; Ecc 7:2; Isa 5:12; 25:6; Jer 16:8; Dan 1:5,8,10,16; 5:10). 46 occurrences. Hyphenated to mark the drinking-aspect; KJV 'feast' loses the wine-element.
Archaic 'mortal-men / handful' (Gen 18:11; 24:35,36; 26:7; 32:6 [5]; 34:30; 46:34; Deu 2:34; 3:6; 4:27; 26:5; 28:62; 33:6; Jdg 20:48; 1Ki 5:11; 1Chr 16:19; etc.). 22 occurrences. Standard concordant.
Hapax (Isa 25:10). The straw-heap trampled in dunghill. Hyphenated.
Used (2Ki 19:28; Ps 32:9; 39:2 [1]; Pro 26:3; Isa 37:29). Horse-bit / bridle. Hyphenated.
Hapax (2Sa 8:1). Place-name 'bridle-of-the-mother-city'. Hyphenated; English convention preserves compound.
Adjective; sweet-taste (Jdg 14:14,18; Job 20:12; Pro 9:17; 16:24; 24:13; 27:7; Ecc 5:11 [12]; 11:7; Song 2:3; Isa 5:20; Eze 3:3). 12 occurrences. Standard.
Used (Joe 1:6; Ps 58:7 [6]; Pro 30:14). The biting-teeth. Hyphenated.
Used (Jdg 20:48; Ps 38:4,8 [3,7]; Isa 1:6). Wholeness / health. Standard.
The loin-area / waist (Gen 37:34; Ex 12:11; 28:42; Deu 33:11; 1Ki 2:5; 8:19; etc.). 48 occurrences. Standard.
Used (Gen 25:6; Num 18:11; 2Sa 19:43 [42]; Pro 15:27; 18:16; 19:6; 21:14; Esth 9:22; etc.). 5 occurrences. Standard.
Multiple persons (2Ki 11:18; 2Chr 23:17; Jer 38:1; Neh 11:11). 3 occurrences. Means 'gift'. English convention.
Multiple persons (Ezr 10:33,37; Neh 12:19). 3 occurrences. English convention.

Multiple persons including Zedekiah's pre-throne name (2Ki 24:17; 1Chr 9:15; 25:4,16; 2Chr 20:14; 29:13; Ezr 10:26-37; Neh 11:17,22; 12:8,25,35; 13:13). 16 occurrences. Means 'gift-of-YH'. English convention.
Verb of becoming-sweet (Job 20:12; 21:33; 24:20; Ps 55:15 [14]; Pro 9:17). 5 occurrences. Hyphenated stative.
Hapax (Job 24:20). Same kernel as H4986; separate MT-entry.
Used (Esth 9:22; Eze 46:11,16-17; Pro 25:14; Ecc 3:13; 5:18 [19]). 6 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Multiple persons (1Chr 9:31; 15:18,21; 16:5; 25:3,21; Ezr 10:43; Neh 8:4). 8 occurrences. English convention.

Particle of entreaty / urgency (Gen 12:11,13; 13:8,9,14; 15:5; 16:2; 18:3,4,21,27,30,31,32; 19:2,7,8,18,19,20; 22:2; etc.). 403 occurrences. Standard. KJV 'now/I-pray-thee'; concordant 'please' captures the entreaty-kernel without archaism.
Egyptian Thebes (Jer 46:25; Eze 30:14-16; Nah 3:8). 5 occurrences. Hyphenated; English convention.
Used (Jos 9:4,13; Jdg 4:19; 1Sa 16:20; Ps 56:9 [8]; 119:83). Wineskin / waterskin. Hyphenated.
Hapax (Jer 23:31). The verb of prophetic-utterance. Standard.

Verb (Ex 20:14 [13]; Lev 20:10; Deu 5:18 [17]; Job 24:15; Ps 50:18; Pro 6:32; 30:20; Jer 3:8,9; 5:7; 7:9; 9:1 [2]; 23:10,14; 29:23; Eze 16:32,38; 23:37,45; Hos 3:1; 4:2,13,14; 7:4; Mal 3:5). 31 occurrences. Hyphenated technical-term; KJV 'commit adultery' (two words); concordant uses hyphen.
Used twice (Jer 13:27; Eze 23:43). The adulterous-act-noun. Standard.
Used twice (2Ki 19:3; Isa 37:3). The contempt / reproach. Standard.
Used (Eze 30:24; Pro 5:11; Job 24:12; Mal 2:13). Substantive of na'aq. Standard.
Priestly city (1Sa 21:1; 22:9,11,19; Neh 11:32; Isa 10:32). 6 occurrences. English convention.
Mountain in Moab and town in Judah (Num 32:3,38; 33:47; Deu 32:49; 34:1; 1Chr 5:8; Ezr 2:29; 10:43; Neh 7:33; Isa 15:2; Jer 48:1,22). 12 occurrences. English convention.
Babylonian captain of guard (2Ki 25:8-20; Jer 39:9-13; 40:1-5; 41:10; 43:6; 52:12-30). 15 occurrences. English convention.
Aramaic variant in Daniel/Ezra (Dan 1-5; Ezr 5:12). 34 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Vineyard-owner murdered by Jezebel (1Ki 21; 2Ki 9:21,25-26). 22 occurrences. English convention.
Manassite person and city (Num 32:42; Jdg 8:11). 3 occurrences. English convention.
Feminine of navi (Ex 15:20; Jdg 4:4; 2Ki 22:14; 2Chr 34:22; Neh 6:14; Isa 8:3). 6 occurrences. Standard.
Eldest son of Ishmael, Arabian tribe (Gen 25:13; 28:9; 36:3; 1Chr 1:29; Isa 60:7). 5 occurrences. English convention.
